# Fathur Portfolio

> Portfolio site for Agus Fathurrahman Rifai (Fathur), an IT student at Universitas Brawijaya specializing in UI/UX Design and Frontend Development.

This is a single-page personal portfolio built with React, GSAP, and Tailwind CSS. It showcases web development projects, graphic/apparel design work, professional experience, and skills in React, Figma, GSAP, Tailwind CSS, Next.js, and TypeScript.

## Sections

- [Home](https://porto-fathur.vercel.app/): Portfolio landing page with hero section
- [About](https://porto-fathur.vercel.app/#about): Background, education, and personal introduction
- [Skills](https://porto-fathur.vercel.app/#skills): Technical skills and design tools
- [Experience](https://porto-fathur.vercel.app/#experience): Work and community involvement (Provoks Multimedia, PKKMB, internships)
- [Projects](https://porto-fathur.vercel.app/#projects): Portfolio of web development and graphic design projects
- [Contact](https://porto-fathur.vercel.app/#contact): Email, phone, and social links
